tasks.title: Strip current and the BEC rating
tasks.statement: A strip of **{n}** WS2812 LEDs, the worst case is white, 0.06 A per LED. The other loads on the same 5 V rail are **{o} A**. What minimum BEC rating is needed by the rule “rating ≥ 1.5 × the sum”, in A?
tasks.solution: The strip current is I = n · 0.06 A; the sum with the other loads; the BEC rating ≥ 1.5 × (n · 0.06 + the others).

tasks.title: How many LEDs a BEC can handle
tasks.statement: A 5 V BEC rated at **{b} A**, other loads of **{o} A**. How many LEDs (0.06 A each on white) can be powered from it by the rule “rating ≥ 1.5 × the sum”? The answer is an integer.
tasks.solution: What is left for the strip is b / 1.5 − the others; divide by 0.06 A and round down: n = ⌊(b / 1.5 − the others) / 0.06⌋.

tasks.title: The number of shots on a leg
tasks.statement: The shutter fires at every multiple of **{N} m** of the trip distance. A leg **{L} m** long starts when the trip distance was **{d0} m**. How many shots are taken on the leg? (The leg starts outside the trigger window.)
tasks.solution: The shots are tied to the distance since arming: n = ⌊(d₀ + L) / N⌋ − ⌊d₀ / N⌋. A plain ⌊L / N⌋ can be off by one shot.

tasks.title: The minimum distance window
tasks.statement: INAV logic is evaluated 10 times a second, and the window “remainder < W” must last at least two ticks. The ground speed is **{v} m/s**. What is the minimum W, in m?
tasks.solution: Two logic ticks are 0.2 s; in that time the aircraft covers W = 0.2 s · v.

tasks.title: The satellite count cycle
tasks.statement: The `BEEPER` mode, a GPS fix, **{s}** satellites. How many milliseconds does one cycle of beeps last (a beep of 50 ms, a pause of 100 ms, a last pause of 500 ms, no more than 10 beeps)?

tasks.title: A mode range boundary
tasks.statement: A boundary of **{v} µs** is entered in the `aux` line for the USER1 mode. What value does the CLI show when the line is read back, in µs?
tasks.solution: The range is stored in steps of 25 µs from 900: step = ⌊(v − 900) / 25⌋, and 900 + 25 · step is printed back.

tasks.title: The hue of the L function
tasks.statement: An LED with the base function `L` (without the `T` overlay), the battery charge is **{p} %**. What hue H (0…359) does the INAV 9.1.0 firmware set?
